Here is the side-by-side pricing tier comparison UI designed according to your brief. 

First, we will initialize the surface:

<a2ui-json>
{
  "version": "v0.9.1",
  "createSurface": {
    "surfaceId": "subscription-pricing-surface",
    "catalogId": "https://a2uicatalog.ai/catalog/c-marketing-commerce.json"
  }
}
</a2ui-json>

  "updateComponents": {

    "components": [

        "id": "root",
        "component": "pricing_tier_group",
        "tiers": [

            ],

            "cta_url": "#starter",
            "recommended": false,
            "popular": false
          },
          {
